query: What are the countries having at least one car maker? List name and id.
ground_truth: SELECT T1.CountryName ,  T1.CountryId FROM COUNTRIES AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.CountryId  =  T2.Country GROUP BY T1.CountryId HAVING count(*)  >=  1;
subqueries: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) FROM car_makers GROUP BY Country HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
final_sql: SELECT countries.CountryId, countries.CountryName FROM countries WHERE countries.CountryId IN (SELECT car_makers.Country FROM car_makers GROUP BY car_makers.Country HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1)
pred: SELECT countries.CountryId, countries.CountryName FROM countries WHERE countries.CountryId IN (SELECT car_makers.Country FROM car_makers GROUP BY car_makers.Country HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1)

query: Which countries in europe have at least 3 car manufacturers?
ground_truth: SELECT T1.CountryName FROM COUNTRIES AS T1 JOIN CONTINENTS AS T2 ON T1.Continent  =  T2.ContId JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T3 ON T1.CountryId  =  T3.Country WHERE T2.Continent  =  'europe' GROUP BY T1.CountryName HAVING count(*)  >=  3;
subqueries: SELECT countries.CountryName, COUNT(car_makers.Id) AS ManufacturerCount FROM countries JOIN car_makers ON countries.CountryId = car_makers.Country GROUP BY countries.CountryName

SELECT CountryName FROM (SELECT countries.CountryName, COUNT(car_makers.Id) AS ManufacturerCount FROM countries JOIN car_makers ON countries.CountryId = car_makers.Country GROUP BY countries.CountryName) AS CountryManufacturerCount WHERE ManufacturerCount >= 3 AND Continent = 'europe'
final_sql: SELECT CountryName FROM (SELECT countries.CountryName, COUNT(car_makers.Id) AS ManufacturerCount FROM countries JOIN car_makers ON countries.CountryId = car_makers.Country GROUP BY countries.CountryName) AS CountryManufacturerCount WHERE ManufacturerCount >= 3 AND Continent = 'europe'
pred:
SELECT CountryName 
FROM (
    SELECT countries.CountryName, COUNT(car_makers.Id) AS ManufacturerCount 
    FROM countries 
    JOIN car_makers ON countries.CountryId = car_makers.Country 
    WHERE countries.Continent = 'europe'
    GROUP BY countries.CountryName
) AS CountryManufacturerCount 
WHERE ManufacturerCount >= 3
